Q0510

“The curse which lies upon marriage is that too often the individuals…” — Simone de Beauvoir (The Second Sex (1949), Vol. II)

Verified English quotation. Primary source: The Second Sex (1949), Vol. II. Theme: relation.

Quotes / Simone de Beauvoir / Q0510

The curse which lies upon marriage is that too often the individuals are joined in their weakness rather than in their strength.

About Simone de Beauvoir

Simone de Beauvoir (1908–1986) was a French existentialist philosopher and novelist whose The Second Sex (1949) transformed feminist theory. A Normalienne, she partnered intellectually with Sartre while building an independent oeuvre on ethics, aging, and politics.
